faq.q: What content can the worksheets practise?
faq.a: Content modes include uppercase A–Z, lowercase a–z, both together, Hindi Varnamala (अ–ष), numbers 0–9 or 1–100, cursive letter joins, sight words, pre-writing patterns, and your own custom words or sentences. Quick presets like Nursery, LKG, UKG, Class 1–2, Cursive introduction and Hindi Varnamala set a sensible combination for each level.

faq.q: What ruling and tracing styles are supported?
faq.a: Ruling options are four-line English, two-line, single-line, Devanagari (with a shirorekha header line) and a blank grid. Trace styles are solid grey (trace over), dotted/outline, 'first solid then faded', and blank lines for free practice. You can also adjust line height, lines per page, trace opacity, and toggle red start-point dots that mark where each letter begins.

faq.q: Can I add name/date/class fields and print it?
faq.a: Yes. There's an editable worksheet title plus optional Name, Date and Class fields in the header. Output is A4. Print directly (the print stylesheet hides the controls and page-breaks each sheet), save the current page as PNG, or export all pages as a PDF. The PDF converts at 96 px per inch so A4 prints as A4 with the ruling intact.

faq.q: Does this tool score tracing done on screen?
faq.a: The About section mentions an accuracy score, but this version is a printable worksheet generator — it builds guide sheets you trace on paper, not an interactive canvas you draw on. It's suited to ages 3 and up, and your last setup (mode, ruling, font, fields, custom text) is remembered in your browser under handwriting-practice-setup-v1.
